deploybot: Canary deploy started for `inference-runtime` in `prod-usw2` by lisa.release — tag: v2.14.0-canary, commit `8f3a1b2`. Change window: 2026-03-20T15:00Z–2026-03-20T16:00Z. Initial traffic: 2%. Instances: 10. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v2.14.0-canary. /cc @jamal.oncall @priya.sre

lisa.release: starting quick smoke checks now, watching latency and 5xx. ping if anything pops. :eyes:

jamal.oncall: oncall here, ack. I'll watch dashboards + pager thresholds (5xx > 2% or p50 > 1200ms).

priya.sre: added a perf probe from canary pool: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/internal/health` every 30s -> canary-health stream. Also enabled extra kv cache metrics.

andrew.pm: QA running prompt-sanity suite (suite: prompt-sanity-v3), ETA ~10m. Will post failures here.

ci-bot: Canary smoke tests kicked off: 18 tests. 0 failed so far. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/1234 (tailing).

lisa.release: saw a small p90 blip at 15:07Z (~1.8x baseline) but p50 looks stable. Jamal, Priya — any infra signals?

priya.sre: no infra alerts. Looks like KV cache warmup on new replicas (cold KV segments). Expect p90 to normalize as warmup finishes. I'm watching KV hit-rate and doccache miss ratio.

jamal.oncall: noted. If this persists >10m we consider rollback. Will signal here.

ci-bot: QA results: 0 critical failures, 2 flaky tests retried and passed. Report: https://ci.redwood/reports/1234/canary

lisa.release: OK holding for one more health window (~10m) then promote to 10% if stable.

deploybot: Canary health window complete — metrics within thresholds. p50/p90/p99 stable; 5xx = 0.8% (<2%). Promoting to 10% traffic now. Applying traffic-policy: gradual-shift 2%->10% over 60s.

priya.sre: promoted to 10%. Warmup continues, keep an eye on quantization kernel traces — we saw tokenization misalignments earlier in similar builds. Logging enabled for tokenization-regress stream.

andrew.pm: pinging analytics to validate top-level user metrics (latency, success, errors).

ci-bot: Runbook note appended: no rollback triggers hit during canary. Artifacts pinned at `v2.14.0-canary` -> promoted artifacts path: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v2.14.0.

lisa.release: plan: promote to full rollout in ~30m if no regressions. shout now if you want to hold. :+1:

jamal.oncall: :thumbsup: No blockers from oncall.

priya.sre: I'd like one more 10m window to confirm KV hit rate normalized — suggest delaying full promote by 10m.

lisa.release: OK holding additional 10m, thanks Priya.

deploybot: Promotion to 100% scheduled at 2026-03-20T15:45Z (gradual ramp over 10m). Will perform step-ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% with health checks between steps. Notifying stakeholders.

ci-bot: Draft release note: "v2.14.0 — inference-runtime: kernel selection fixes, perf optimizations, KV cache warmup improvements. Canary promoted 2026-03-20; tag: v2.14.0; commit: 8f3a1b2." Edit at: https://docs.redwood/releases/2.14.0

lisa.release: thanks. I'll post to #releases once 100% complete.

deploybot: Rollout complete: `inference-runtime` v2.14.0 at 100% in `prod-usw2`. Start 2026-03-20T15:00Z, end 2026-03-20T15:55Z. No rollbacks. Metrics: p50=220ms (baseline 210ms), 5xx=0.6%. Tag promoted to `v2.14.0` (commit `8f3a1b2`). Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v2.14.0. Release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/2.14.0. /cc @all
